actual: After the 2026-08-13 user restart, backend-main loaded a descendant of both merged BUG-992 slices, but production run simrun_7bf1e0c1b6b7d055 remained FAILED_RETRYABLE. Its durable payload contains continuous economic generations 1..4: generations 1..3 belong to predecessor plan plan_295a79eab064130c, while generation 4 and the current run identity belong to cash-fit successor plan plan_4e346c75b6a5f0e5. The strict closure incorrectly required every historical receipt/state to use the current plan and failed with LOCALSIM_DURABLE_STATE_AUTHORITY_RECEIPT_IDENTITY_CONFLICT; after authority selection, active FAILED_RETRYABLE generations were still excluded from the durable minute-loop recovery path. After PR #3422 merged, the lineage closure passes, but both durable plans carry the pre-retirement V25_1_SMALL_CAP execution policy: the TWAP-only existing-plan assert typed-rejects the current plan with LOCALSIM_LEGACY_EXECUTION_PLAN_POLICY_RETIRED, and the retry carrier classified this permanent policy rejection as transient, applying exponential backoff indefinitely (10 consecutive failures on 2026-08-17) so the run never leaves FAILED_RETRYABLE.

Replacement creates new state identities; current-identity progress remains guarded by the existing exact sequence+1 and state-hash CAS. Unknown plans, plan rollback, hash, intent or immutable semantic drift must fail loud. Historical FAILED_RETRYABLE and FAILED_TERMINAL active generations automatically continue without parent resubmit or predecessor projection replay.
fix_summary: Require independent durable ExecutionPlan readback for predecessor/rebuild/current lineage, exact frozen-intent/trading-rule/cash-fit closure, and existing current-state CAS progression while preserving predecessor receipt hashes as audit history. Extend no-parent-resubmit recovery to historical FAILED_RETRYABLE with distinct typed evidence. 2026-08-18 continuation: recognize the F-122 TWAP-only retired-plan typed reject during historical failed-run recovery and terminalize the run as FAILED_TERMINAL with a hash-closed localsim_historical_legacy_plan_terminalization_v1 evidence carrier and zero side effects, instead of retrying the permanent policy rejection forever; non-retired policy errors stay on the existing retryable path.
non_goals: Do not start, stop, or restart any user backend without explicit per-target approval.
root_cause: The first authority repair assumed a run has one plan identity for its full economic receipt history. In the observed production lifecycle, side-effect-free LocalSIM plan rebuild and subsequent cash-fit legitimately produced predecessor and successor plans in one run: generations 1..3 plus 246 predecessor states remain auditable, while generation 4 plus 246 successor states are current. The closure rejected the valid predecessor history before selecting generation 4. Separately, historical active-generation recovery only admitted FAILED_TERMINAL, so a FAILED_RETRYABLE current generation could never be driven to terminal closure even after authority readback succeeded. Third layer (2026-08-18): both durable plans were created before the F-122 TWAP-only retirement and carry V25_1_SMALL_CAP. Once the merged lineage closure succeeds, historical recovery reaches _load_existing_plan_context, whose TWAP-only assert raises the permanent typed rejection LOCALSIM_LEGACY_EXECUTION_PLAN_POLICY_RETIRED; _run_recovery_item_isolated has no permanent-failure classification, so it recorded the rejection as a transient retry failure with exponential backoff and the run stayed FAILED_RETRYABLE/BLOCKED forever.
